description:
Dixie
Alabama State Souvenir Plate
Porcelain, Multi-Color, Vintage
Vintage porcelain souvenir plate celebrating the state of Alabama, produced by Dixie in Japan. This collectible piece features iconic landmarks of the Heart of Dixie, including Birmingham's Vulcan statue, the State Capitol in Montgomery, the USS Alabama in Mobile, and the Space and Rocket Center in Huntsville. State souvenir plates were popular mid-century mementos, often collected during road trips to commemorate visits to historic sites across the American South.
Detailed multi-color transfer graphic featuring major Alabama landmarks and state map outline
Classic white porcelain center with a decorative light green border band
Gilded gold-tone trim along the scalloped outer edge
Original "Dixie Japan" foil sticker on base; "NOT FOR FOOD" stamped in red on underside
Measures approximately 6.25 inches in diameter
Condition:
The central transfer graphic is vibrant and fully intact with no significant fading or loss. Minor wear is present on the gold-toned rim trim, consistent with vintage display. The porcelain surface is free of chips, cracks, or crazing. Base shows light shelf wear; intended for decorative display only as indicated by the manufacturer's mark.
